Hanoi, Vietnam Map Hanoi > Guest houses > My Homestay Hanoi View all photos My Homestay Hanoi Located just 1.5 km from the ornate colonial Opera House, My Homestay Hanoi hotel is 6 minutes' walk from the famous Hoa Lo Prison. This guest house also includes street parking. The hotel is nestled within 20 minutes' walk of Thien Quang Lake. The majestic church "Saint Joseph Cathedral" is within a 700-metre distance of the property, and the French Quarter is a mere 1.6 km away. The bustling Hanoi Night Market is a short way from the My Homestay. 7 Dien Bien Phu bus stop is approximately 5 minutes by car from this hotel and 10 minutes on foot from is enough to get to Ha Noi train station. The accommodation offers rooms with a balcony and a sitting area featuring climate control, along with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. They are appointed with a writing desk, and also feature a minibar.
